name: What a line asks of me
says: the router reads whether a line asks a question, sets a task or gives a fact as the AMI Meeting Corpus's annotators marked its dialogue act, and as DialogBank's gold annotation marks each act of its dialogues, under ISO 24617-2's general-purpose functions

measures.says: percent of the AMI scenario test partition's Elicit acts (test/oracle/corpus.json) the router reads as a question
percent of its Suggest and Offer acts the router reads as a task, once the meaning model has opened (the intent head, PROVIDERS.intent.head)
percent of its Inform acts the router reads as a fact (an untimed event counted as one)
percent of the task dimension's information-seeking acts (DialogBank's readable English dialogues, held out of the repository and read at their pins) the router reads as a question
percent of its directive and commissive acts that open an action (instruct, request, suggest, offer, promise) the router reads as a task
percent of its information-providing acts the router reads as a fact
